lineas: Please turn off your phone during the exam

mensajes.texto: Hi Tom! Are you going to the school fair?
Yes, I am. I will meet my friends there at three o'clock.
Great! Can I come with you?

estimulos.texto: My name is Laura and I live in Cúcuta. I have a small dog called Max. Every morning I walk with him before school. In the afternoon, I do my homework and play the guitar.

preguntas.correcta: You must not use your phone here.

errores: Reads «turn off» as «only calls are allowed».
Confuses the instruction with a service.
preguntas.justificacion: «No mobile phones» means it is forbidden to use phones.

preguntas.enunciado: Mary ____ her homework every day after school.
preguntas.pregunta: Choose the correct option to complete the sentence.
errores: Wrong verb form for «Mary» (third person singular).
Mixes the auxiliary «is» with the base verb.
preguntas.justificacion: With third person singular in present simple, we use «does».

preguntas.pregunta: What does Laura do in the morning?
errores: The text does not mention the park.
preguntas.justificacion: The text says: «Every morning I walk with him before school».

preguntas.enunciado: A person who teaches students at school is a ____.

A farmer works in the countryside.
preguntas.justificacion: A teacher is the person who teaches students at school.
